description: Free: is every payTo of this x402 endpoint really its seller's? Per payment option, one outcome of the draft ERC "x402 Payee Verification for ERC-8004 Agents": verified-wallet (the payTo is the agent wallet registered in the ERC-8004 Identity Registry), verified-delegation (the agent wallet signed an EIP-712 payee delegation for it), mismatch, invalid-delegation, endpoint-unlisted, no-agent-wallet or not-read. The identity comes from the 402's extra.erc8004 or the seller's /.well-known/agent-registration.json. Never pays. Shares the free limit of 10 calls per hour.

body.description: Example JSON request body, for a POST route that checks its input before the 402 (implies POST). Without it, {} is sent and the requestBody example in the endpoint's /openapi.json is tried.

method.description: HTTP method of the paid route (default: GET, then POST)

url.description: The x402 endpoint (public http(s) URL), e.g. https://api.example.com/paid

name: x402_payee_check

agent.description: The identity checked: registry, agentId, block read, agent wallet

payees.description: Per payment option: network, payTo, asset, outcome (verified-wallet, verified-delegation, mismatch, invalid-delegation, endpoint-unlisted, no-agent-wallet, not-read) and reason

status.description: pass: every payTo is bound to the seller's agent; warn: some are not; info: could not confirm; none: no ERC-8004 identity found

title: ERC-8004 payee verification (free)
